assets.role: Baku courtyard, waterfront, old-city house, skyline with flame-shaped towers, internship lab with CORE workstation and ADS-B tracker model
assets.provenance: Original work generated by the project's own Blender Python scripts; no third-party assets.
assets.notes: Tracker_Pan / Tracker_Tilt / Tracker_Plane are separate so the runtime animates a simulated track. Water_* meshes receive the runtime water shader.

assets.role: Globe: ocean, simplified continents, cloud clusters (Globe_Clouds), marker pins and anchors for London and Azerbaijan
assets.provenance: Original work generated by the project's own Blender Python scripts; no third-party assets.
assets.notes: Marker positions come from real coordinates (London 51.51N 0.13W; Baku 40.41N 49.87E). Atmosphere rim is a runtime shader.

assets.role: Playable character: rigged, skinned, with 10 named animation clips
assets.provenance: Original work generated by the project's own Blender Python scripts; no third-party assets.
assets.notes: Clips: Idle, Walk, Run, Turn, Wave, Interact, Sit, Type, PetDog, Jump. Hair bones (Hair1-3, HairSide.L/R) and Eye bones (blink) are driven procedurally at runtime.

assets.provenance: Original work generated by the project's own Blender Python scripts; no third-party assets.
assets.notes: Door_Home pivots on its origin (hinge); `open_angle` extra is the open rotation in degrees around the vertical axis.

assets.role: Home interior: room shell, removable occluders, furniture, desk, monitor + separate screen, interaction anchors
